//: Pixel-tier box-projection world-size multipliers. Default 1.0: the band-limited albedo_pixel variants (tools/pbr/build_palette_variants.py) already match the texel budget, so changing the projection size would move the surface off that budget. Kept as recorded data because a material whose feature pitch is still wrong at the texel grid needs a documented per-material multiplier, not a code fork.

iron_directorate__metal_trim.because: base-mesh units carry curved organic surfaces; the 1x camo pitch aliases to speckle at the 2 cm texel grid, 2x makes the pattern read as camo blocks (A/B on the line infantry base master)

iron_directorate__armour_primary.because: base-mesh units: 2 cm texel grid turns 1x/2x camo pitch into sub-pixel speckle at the 256 px master; 4x makes the pattern read as camo blocks (A/B on the line infantry base master)

deck_plate_industrial.because: authored at 4 m for the tier

iron_directorate__armour_secondary.because: base-mesh units: 2 cm texel grid turns 1x/2x camo pitch into sub-pixel speckle at the 256 px master; 4x makes the pattern read as camo blocks (A/B on the line infantry base master)
